page.layout: One centred title page, with a woodcut device (anchor, snake and two figures) between the title and the imprint. Title block above, imprint below.

l.i: ad nostram hanc ætatem in Germania, Gallia,

page.notes: The woodcut device between the title and the imprint shows an anchor with a serpent coiled round its shank and two figures at the sides, with the letters I and C beside it. It is an engraving and not transcribed. The handwritten name "Jean Crespin" with a tick mark, the dark ink or redaction bars at the right and foot, and the small cross at the top left are handwriting, stains or marks, not printed text, and are left out. The long s is written as a plain s. The u/v spelling is normalised in capitals (EORUM, QUI, HUSSO). The "ET" line is a ligature, not an ampersand. "demùm" keeps its printed grave accent.
